goal: Bind W24/W25 physical Analysis fixtures to the HQ-approved W22 corpus and prevent unrepresentatively easy physical subsets.

implementation.subset_mode: requires an exact HQ-approved fixture set and explicit minima for all five Analysis domains and every W22 stratum; minima cannot weaken W22
downstream_binding: W24 required fixture IDs and durations exactly match W26 selection
W25 fixture inventory exactly matches W26 selection
W25 source SHA-256 and duration match the canonical W22 manifest
downstream W25/W24 evaluation is suppressed unless W26 selection is ready

coverage: valid exact subset preserving W22 floors

stress.meaning: selection-evaluator overhead only; not physical-iPhone Analysis performance

remaining_gates: HQ must supply an approved production W26 selection policy or choose full W22 corpus mode
HQ must execute W23/W25/W24 on a physical iPhone
source-loader provenance and actual source bytes remain Lane 2/HQ responsibilities
archived JSON authenticity and physical-device origin are not cryptographically established by W26
